summary: Frontend-only verification of new Partner Declaration & Terms consent gate on /signup, the /terms page, and regression of /login and /admin/login. All assertions in the review request passed on desktop (1440) and mobile (390). Test user cleaned up from MongoDB.
verified_behavior: /signup renders Full Name, Email, Mobile, Password inputs + terms-consent box (data-testid present).
terms-toggle header shows 'Radhika Traders – Partner Declaration & Terms' with 'Read' label; chevron rotates.
terms-scroll is hidden initially; clicking terms-toggle reveals it (max-height=224px ~14rem, overflow-y=auto, scrollHeight=1937px → internal scroll works).
partner-terms-body contains 15 numbered sections including '1. INDEPENDENT PARTNER STATUS' and '15. KYC & WITHDRAWAL'.
signup-submit is disabled while terms-checkbox is unchecked, even after filling all form fields (click produced no submission - Playwright timed out on disabled button as expected).

After checking terms-checkbox, signup-submit becomes enabled; submitting with valid data advanced to step 2 'Verify your email' with signup-otp input visible (toast 'OTP sent to your email' shown; backend accepted the registration).
Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow on /signup; terms-scroll keeps internal scroll (clientHeight=222, scrollHeight=2190).
/terms page renders terms-page, h1 'Radhika Traders – Partner Declaration & Terms', version '2026-10' visible, 15 sections, and terms-signup-link → /signup.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup.jsx L18: localStorage write happens during render (side-effect in render body). Should be moved into useEffect to avoid React strict-mode double writes. Minor, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Signed up temp user bhatiharish276+tt1@gmail.com (step-1 only, no OTP verify). Deleted from users (1) and otp_codes (1) collections after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Terms consent gate on /signup works end-to-end. /auth/register already verified by main agent via curl. If re-running, use a different email alias to avoid duplicate-user conflicts.
